corpus.scope: Image-only sample (*.png, *.jpg), discovered recursively. The raw arm's production scanner indexes ZERO of these; the image-ocr-v1 arm OCRs and indexes them all.

arms.label: raw — production FileScanner(.raw) excludes every image (empty index)

queries.text: How many total charges does the chart report against January 6 defendants?

passage_criteria.note: the '1,575 total charges' callout; OCR may drop or change the thousands separator

queries.rationale: The chart's red callout reads '1,575 total charges through Jan. 2025'; a note says the FBI estimated ~2,000 people took part in criminal acts on Jan. 6. Query targets what the chart states, not external truth.

queries.text: How are insert and delete edits from two clients transformed against the server document?
queries.rationale: Columns Time / Client A / Server / Client B show Insert(at: 0, text: x) and Delete(at: 1, n: 2) converging on document 'xad' — an operational-transformation sequence.

queries.text: How do fractional index values let you insert an object between two ordered items?
queries.rationale: Steps read 'Insert Obj2 between Obj3 & Obj4' (value 0.35), 'Insert Obj0 before Obj1' (0.05), and 'Insert Obj5 after Obj4' (0.5) — fractional ordering keys.

queries.text: Which image is the Minecraft video thumbnail titled ATMOSPHERE?
queries.rationale: The thumbnail shows large white text 'ATMOSPHERE' over a Minecraft interior, with the stylized creator tag 'BDOUBLEO' beneath (the stylized slashed-O may not OCR cleanly, so only ATMOSPHERE is checked).

queries.text: What hydration percentage does a country sourdough loaf use?
queries.rationale: Rendered text states '75 percent hydration' and names 'the Tartine method'.
